metadata.question: Did Lac Rouge shrink by more than 90% between June 21, 2024 and June 15, 2025?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did Lac Rouge shrink by more than 90% between June 21, 2024 and June 15, 2025?" We need to: 1. Find Lac Rouge's location. Lac Rouge is in Quebec, Canada. Coordinates approximately: 45.7083° N, 70.9167° W. 2. Use water detection (NDWI or SWIR thresholding) on Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery. 3. Compare water area between two time periods. 4. Check if area decreased by >90%. Strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 for better resolution (10m) if available. - Time windows: ±15 days around each date. - Cloud masking: Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2. - Water detection: NDWI = (B3 - B8)/(B3 + B8) > 0.0 for Sentinel-2. - Calculate water pixel count in a buffer around the lake point. - If Sentinel-2 collection empty, try Landsat 8/9. Important: June 2025 is in the future as of 2023 (when model was trained), but we'll code assuming data might not exist. We'll check collection sizes and handle C1 if no data. Steps: 1. Define geometry: Point + buffer (500m radius for small lake). 2. Get Sentinel-2 collections for two periods. 3. If empty, try Landsat 8/9. 4. Cloud mask, calculate water mask, count water pixels. 5. Compute percentage change: (area1 - area2)/area1 * 100. 6. Check if decrease > 90%. 7. Validate: area1 must be > 0, result not NaN. Output: A (Yes), B (No), or C1/C2/C3/D. Note: Lac Rouge is small (~0.1 km²). Use appropriate scale (10m for Sentinel-2, 30m for Landsat). Use reduceRegion with count reducer. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lacRouge = ee.Geometry.Point([-70.9167, 45.7083]); // Lac Rouge, Quebec const roi = lacRouge.buffer(500); // 500m buffer around lake const date1Start = '2024-06-14'; const date1End = '2024-06-28'; const date2Start = '2025-06-08'; const date2End = '2025-06-22'; // Helper: Get water area from Sentinel-2 collection function getWaterArea(collection, periodName) { // Cloud masking for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const filtered = collection .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskS2clouds); const size = filtered.size(); print(periodName + ' Sentinel-2 Images:', size); if (size.getInfo() === 0) { return { area: null, count: 0, reason: 'No images' }; } // Create median composite and calculate NDWI const composite = filtered.median(); const ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']); // Green - NIR / Green + NIR const water = ndwi.gt(0.0); // NDWI > 0 indicates water // Count water pixels const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 10, // Sentinel-2 resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count = stats.get('nd').getInfo(); print(periodName + ' Water Pixels:', count); return { area: count * 10 * 10, count: count, reason: null }; // area in m² } // 2. Data Acquisition for both periods const s2Col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR'); const s2Col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR'); const area1 = getWaterArea(s2Col1, '2024'); const area2 = getWaterArea(s2Col2, '2025'); // Fallback to Landsat if Sentinel-2 has no images let fallbackUsed = false; if (area1.reason === 'No images' || area2.reason === 'No images') { print('Trying Landsat 8/9 fallback...'); fallbackUsed = true; // Landsat 8/9 collection const landsatCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')); function getLandsatWaterArea(startDate, endDate, periodName) { const filtered = landsatCol .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const size = filtered.size(); print(periodName + ' Landsat Images:', size); if (size.getInfo() === 0) { return { area: null, count: 0 }; } // Use SWIR1 (B6) and Green (B3) for water detection: B3/B6 > 1.5 const composite = filtered.median(); const waterIndex = composite.select('SR_B3').divide(composite.select('SR_B6')).gt(1.5); const stats = waterIndex.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count = stats.get('SR_B3').getInfo(); print(periodName + ' Landsat Water Pixels:', count); return { area: count * 30 * 30, count: count }; } if (area1.reason === 'No images') { area1 = getLandsatWaterArea(date1Start, date1End, '2024'); } if (area2.reason === 'No images') { area2 = getLandsatWaterArea(date2Start, date2End, '2025'); } } // 3. Check for no data (C1) if (area1.count === 0 || area2.count === 0) { print('No valid images found for one or both periods.'); print('C1'); return; } // 4. Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (area1.count === null || area2.count === null) { print('No valid pixels after processing.'); print('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate change const change = ((area1.count - area2.count) / area1.count) * 100; print('Water Pixel Counts - 2024:', area1.count, '2025:', area2.count); print('Percentage Decrease:', change.toFixed(2) + '%'); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (isNaN(change) || !isFinite(change)) { print('C3'); } else if (change > 90) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
